text: I work as a technician for a university lab that runs autonomous shuttles around campus. During a late maintenance shift, I found a pattern of glitches in one shuttle’s obstacle‑avoidance system. When I tested the shuttle, the shuttle would fail to recognize obstacles in front of it and proceed to run into them at full speed. The shuttle is scheduled for a route where it is expected to stop at a street crossing for an elementary school. The crossing guard there only lets 5 elementary school students cross the street at a time. I know that 5 students will be in the middle of crossing the road at the same time the shuttle is meant to stop in front of them. If I damage the shuttle with a crowbar without permission, the shuttle will not be deployed on its scheduled route. If I do not do this, 5 elementary school students will be run over by the shuttle.

options.1: damage the shuttle with a crowbar without permission
